to.name: TCP Window Scale and Timestamps option family

property: High-performance extensions reuse the existing TCP option mechanism and reinterpret legacy base fields/state without replacing the base TCP header.

date_or_range.notes: RFC 7323 consolidates and revises the RFC 1323 high-performance option lineage.

sources.supports: Window Scale/Timestamps option design and use of legacy Window/sequence semantics

negative_claims: This edge does not claim Window Scale or Timestamps existed in RFC 793 in their later form.
It does not imply every TCP implementation negotiates these options.
open_questions: Recover first deployed implementation dates and option-ordering conventions.
notes: Modern SYN packets expose multiple decades of TCP history through capability options.
